reviews.t: I found the whole kit to be a great addition to my arsenal of beauty products.
reviews.x: Although this is still a hair removing torture device I wish I had gotten one sooner. In the summer my fine blonde peach fuzz on my upper lip stands out when I tan. I no longer want to spend the little free time I have to go to the salon to get waxed like I used to. This hurts just as bad, maybe worse because it gets so many at once, even the the little fine hairs you can't see. But it makes quick work of it all. The tweezers are great to get any unruly strays and keep my eyebrows under control.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product effective at removing facial hair, including fine or single hairs.
A common complaint is that the spring/coiled hair remover is painful, sometimes grabbing or scratching the skin.
Several reviewers note a learning curve and say it takes practice to get the hang of using it.
The tweezers are frequently praised for working well and gripping hairs closely.
Some reviewers report quality or packaging problems, such as receiving an opened package or a blade that barely cuts.
